notes: Server reports completed with limitations, expected for a feasibility-only date split. No independent local access to full-precision server outputs.
q values are inherited from previous B models; these 42 conversions are not 42 new tests or independent replications.
Positive-contrast factor depends on displayed score IQR and exposure support. CI is conditional on anchors and does not include anchor-estimation uncertainty.
Date-split membership counts refer to the original bridge sample, not all seven diet-specific B samples; medians refer to all original bridge members.
MODD proxy is only a clock-bin availability check. No split-window CGM phenotype or beta/p/q was computed.
Selected comparison anchors differ across diets/settings; do not rank scores or test sample differences from these converted effects.
